typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{VM Name} as string,
		{Cluster Name} as string,
		{vCenter Name} as string,
		State as string,
		OS as string,
		vCPUs as string,
		{CPU Reservation} as string,
		{Mem (GB)} as string,
		{Memory Reservation} as string,
		{Unit Count} as string,
		{NIC Count} as string,
		{Disk Count} as string,
		{Total Storage (GB)} as string,
		{vHW Version} as string,
		{Tools Version Status} as string,
		{Tools Running Status} as string,
		{Tools Version} as string,
		{Tools Release} as string,
		IP as string,
		{MAC Address} as string,
		Network as string,
		{Resource Pool} as string,
		Owner as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Owner as string,
		OS as string,
		IP as string,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NIC_Count as string,
		Unit_Count as string,
		Mem__GB_ as string,
		Tools_Version_Status as string,
		VM_Name as string,
		Memory_Reservation as string,
		vHW_Version as string,
		Tools_Version as string,
		Tools_Release as string,
		State as string,
		Tools_Running_Status as string,
		Network as string,
		vCenter_Name as string,
		Disk_Count as string,
		MAC_Address as string,
		CPU_Reservation as string,
		Total_Storage__GB_ as string,
		Cluster_Name as string,
		vCPUs as string,
		Resource_Pool as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Owner,
		OS,
		IP,
		importdate = ImportDate,
		NIC_Count = {NIC Count},
		Unit_Count = {Unit Count},
		Mem__GB_ = {Mem (GB)},
		Tools_Version_Status = {Tools Version Status},
		VM_Name = {VM Name},
		Memory_Reservation = {Memory Reservation},
		vHW_Version = {vHW Version},
		Tools_Version = {Tools Version},
		Tools_Release = {Tools Release},
		State,
		Tools_Running_Status = {Tools Running Status},
		Network,
		vCenter_Name = {vCenter Name},
		Disk_Count = {Disk Count},
		MAC_Address = {MAC Address},
		CPU_Reservation = {CPU Reservation},
		Total_Storage__GB_ = {Total Storage (GB)},
		Cluster_Name = {Cluster Name},
		vCPUs,
		Resource_Pool = {Resource Pool}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
